case_classification.short_description: Regular financial life plan model including debt, salary raises, tax and inflation in spending categories - comparison between two careers

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This wealth management task requires a multi-decade (83-year) dual-scenario projection with highly complex, cascading logic. Key modeling challenges that will consume significant time include: setting up dynamic income tax brackets that index upward annually at 1.95%; compounding 12 different expense categories with distinct inflation and lifestyle inflation factors (triggered only from the second year of work); establishing a debt waterfall that pays down three different loans in order of decreasing interest rate; accounting for a cost-of-living loan drawn at the start of the year; executing tax gross-ups on investment withdrawals during deficits; and scaling up credit card debt when investments are exhausted. Due to the high number of specific questions verifying exact values across both paths, an expert will spend a substantial portion of the time rigorously auditing the formulas to ensure there are no compounding errors.
